reviewer: ENTWURF — Tier D und E sind noch nicht durchgesehen

buildable.name: Stonehenge
buildable.justification: Trilithons and a continuous lintel ring: Column plus a lintel course. Already built as recipes/stonehenge.json, 28 090 instances from cited stone dimensions.

buildable.name: Grand-Place
buildable.justification: A closed square of guildhall facades: Wall for the elevations, Colonnade at ground level, Stair to the Town Hall. Gables are stepped Wall courses.

buildable.name: Jelling Heritage Site
buildable.justification: Two barrows as Dome, two runestones as small blocks, one church as Wall plus roof. The smallest Tier A site and the clearest test of the vocabulary.

buildable.name: The Great Wall
buildable.justification: Wall and Stair, repeated -- the primitive is the site's name. Watchtowers are Column plus Wall.

buildable.name: Memphis and its Necropolis – the Pyramid Fields from Giza to Dahshur
buildable.justification: The Giza pyramids: the Pyramid primitive, stepped in whole courses, which is what a brick pyramid honestly is.

buildable.name: Historic Centre of Rome, the Properties of the Holy See in that City Enjoying Extraterritorial Rights and San Paolo Fuori le Mura
buildable.justification: The Colosseum is Arch on Colonnade, four storeys, which is precisely what the building is. Already partly built as recipes/rom.json.

buildable.name: Acropolis of Athens
buildable.justification: The Parthenon is Colonnade plus Stair plus a pediment of stepped Wall courses.

buildable.name: Taj Mahal
buildable.justification: Dome on a plinth, four Columns as minarets, Arch iwans on each face.

buildable.name: Historic Sanctuary of Machu Picchu
buildable.justification: Terraces as Stair, buildings as Wall. worship? -- the Intihuatana is a ritual stone, not an active place of worship.

buildable.name: Borobudur Temple Compounds
buildable.justification: Stepped terraces (Stair) with stupas (Dome). worship? -- an active Buddhist pilgrimage site.

buildable.name: Cologne Cathedral
buildable.justification: Twin towers as Column, nave as Wall, the whole thing as Arch. worship? -- an active cathedral.

buildable.name: Pont du Gard
buildable.justification: Three tiers of Arch. Nothing else. The cleanest possible demonstration of one primitive.

buildable.name: Petra
buildable.justification: Rock-cut facades as Colonnade and Arch against a Wall face.

buildable.name: Angkor
buildable.justification: Towers as stepped Column, galleries as Colonnade, causeways as Wall. worship? -- parts are in active Buddhist use.

buildable.name: Chichen Itza
buildable.justification: El Castillo is the Pyramid primitive with Stair on all four faces.

buildable.name: Persepolis
buildable.justification: The Apadana is Colonnade on a Stair-approached terrace.

buildable.name: Mesa Verde National Park
buildable.justification: Cliff Palace as stacked Wall and Column under an overhang.

buildable.name: Bauhaus and its Sites in Weimar, Dessau and Bernau
buildable.justification: Wall and glazing grid as Mosaic. A modular building rendered by a modular system, which is the thesis stated twice.

buildable.name: Zollverein Coal Mine Industrial Complex
buildable.justification: Shaft 12's headframe as Column and truss, halls as Wall.

buildable.name: Speicherstadt and Kontorhaus District with Chilehaus
buildable.justification: Brick warehouses: Wall and Arch, and the single most literally brick-built site on the list.

buildable.name: Kronborg Castle
buildable.justification: Bastioned castle: Wall, Column, Stair. Hamlet's Elsinore, and Danish, which the Postillen make relevant.

buildable.name: Belfries of Belgium and France
buildable.justification: The Bruges belfry as a stepped Column. Belgian, likewise.

buildable.name: Wieliczka and Bochnia Royal Salt Mines
buildable.justification: Timbered chambers as Wall and Column. worship? -- the Chapel of St Kinga holds services.

buildable.name: Alhambra, Generalife and Albayzín, Granada
buildable.justification: Courts as Colonnade, the Court of the Lions as Column repeated, Arch throughout.

buildable.name: Mont-Saint-Michel and its Bay
buildable.justification: The abbey as Wall on a Stair-terraced rock. worship? -- an active monastic community.

buildable.name: Sydney Opera House
buildable.justification: The shells are the one site here the vocabulary genuinely strains at -- a Dome is a hemisphere and these are not. Drafted as a candidate for exactly that reason: if it cannot be built honestly it should be dropped and said so.

buildable.name: Brasília
buildable.justification: Niemeyer's Congress: Dome, inverted Dome, twin Wall slabs.

buildable.name: Rapa Nui National Park
buildable.justification: Moai as Column with a pukao course. Ahu platforms as Wall.

buildable.name: Timbuktu
buildable.justification: Djinguereber and Sankore as Wall with projecting toron. worship? -- active mosques.

buildable.name: Bagan
buildable.justification: Stupas as Dome on stepped Stair terraces, repeated at scale. worship? -- active.

buildable.name: Himeji Castle
buildable.justification: The keep as stacked Wall with tiered roofs; roofs as stepped courses.

buildable.name: Vatican City
buildable.justification: Bernini's colonnade is Colonnade, four columns deep, which is the primitive's definition. worship? -- the entire state.

buildable.name: Old Town of Segovia and its Aqueduct
buildable.justification: The aqueduct is Arch on Arch, 167 of them.

buildable.name: Ironbridge Gorge
buildable.justification: The bridge as Arch in cast iron -- the first of its kind, and the industrial rhyme to Act III.

buildable.name: Völklingen Ironworks
buildable.justification: Blast furnaces as Column and Stair. worship? -- no.

buildable.name: Sigiriya
buildable.justification: The rock as a mass, the water gardens as Mosaic, the lion staircase as Stair.

buildable.name: Archaeological Sites of the Island of Meroe
buildable.justification: Nubian pyramids: the Pyramid primitive, steeper than Giza's, repeated across a field.

buildable.name: Great Zimbabwe
buildable.justification: Dry-stone enclosures: Wall, in the most literal sense on this list -- coursed, mortarless, modular.

buildable.name: Fujian Tulou sites
buildable.justification: Circular earthen dwellings: Wall bent into a ring, which is a real test of whether the primitive can curve.

buildable.name: Citadel, Ancient City and Fortress Buildings of Derbent
buildable.justification: Wall running from the citadel to the sea.

buildable.name: Hadrian's Wall
buildable.justification: Hadrian's Wall: Wall and milecastle, the same two primitives 117 km apart.

buildable.name: Tower of London
buildable.justification: Concentric curtain Walls around a keep; the White Tower is a Wall block with corner Columns.

buildable.name: Bath
buildable.justification: The Royal Crescent is a Colonnade bent into an arc -- the one building on this list that is literally an arrangeOn arc.

buildable.name: Blenheim Palace
buildable.justification: Baroque courtyard: Wall ranges, a Colonnade portico, Stair to the terrace.

buildable.name: Palace of Westminster and Westminster Abbey including Saint Margaret's Church
buildable.justification: worship? -- no. Victoria Tower and the Elizabeth Tower as Columns, the river front as Wall.

buildable.name: Old and New Towns of Edinburgh
buildable.justification: The New Town is a grid of terraces: Wall, repeated, which is what a Georgian terrace is.

buildable.name: Roskilde Cathedral
buildable.justification: worship? -- an active cathedral and Denmark's royal burial church. Brick Gothic: Wall and Arch.

buildable.name: Bryggen
buildable.justification: The Hanseatic wharf at Bergen: rows of gabled timber Wall fronts.

buildable.name: Palace and Park of Versailles
buildable.justification: The garden front is 580 m of repeated bay: Wall plus Colonnade, at the largest repetition count on the list.

buildable.name: Notre-Dame de Chartres
buildable.justification: worship? -- an active cathedral. Two unmatched spires as Columns of different heights, which is the building's own signature.

buildable.name: Cité de Carcassonne
buildable.justification: 52 towers on a double curtain: Column on Wall, arrangeOn an arc.

buildable.name: Arles, Roman and Romanesque Monuments
buildable.justification: The Roman amphitheatre: Arch on Arch, the Colosseum's argument at a size the kit handles comfortably.

buildable.name: reconstructed center of Le Havre
buildable.justification: Perret's rebuilt city is a reinforced-concrete module repeated across a whole town centre. If any site on this list IS the thesis, it is this one.

buildable.name: Works of Antoni Gaudí
buildable.justification: The Sagrada Familia's towers are Columns; the rest of Gaudi is ruled surfaces the kit cannot express, and that is worth showing.

buildable.name: Historic City of Toledo
buildable.justification: worship? -- the cathedral is active. Alcazar as a Wall block with four corner Columns.

buildable.name: Monastery and Site of the Escurial, Madrid
buildable.justification: worship? -- an active monastery. A grid of courtyards: Wall, at Herrera's deliberate monotony.

buildable.name: Alcobaça Monastery
buildable.justification: worship? -- an active monastery. Cistercian plan: Wall, Arch, Colonnade cloister.

buildable.name: Aachen Cathedral
buildable.justification: worship? -- active. The Palatine Chapel is an octagon: Colonnade on an arrangeOn circle under a Dome.

buildable.name: Würzburg Residence with the Court Gardens and Residence Square
buildable.justification: worship? -- no. The Residenz is a Wall range with a Stair the building is famous for.

buildable.name: Town of Bamberg
buildable.justification: worship? -- the cathedral is active. A hill town of Wall fronts.

buildable.name: Grachtengordel
buildable.justification: The canal ring: gabled Wall fronts in a row, stepped courses for the gables.

buildable.name: Rietveld Schröder House
buildable.justification: The Schroeder House is planes and lines -- Wall slabs meeting at edges. De Stijl is a modular grammar and this is the test of whether the kit can speak it.

buildable.name: Van Nelle Factory
buildable.justification: Curtain wall as Mosaic, floor slabs as Wall. A factory built as a system.

buildable.name: Imperial Palaces of the Ming and Qing Dynasties in Beijing and Shenyang
buildable.justification: The Forbidden City: courtyard after courtyard of Wall and Stair, 980 buildings on one axis.

buildable.name: Temple of Heaven
buildable.justification: worship? -- ceremonial rather than congregational. The Hall of Prayer is three Domes on a three-tier Stair terrace.

buildable.name: Ancient City of Ping Yao
buildable.justification: 6 km of Ming city Wall with 72 watchtowers, cited and countable.

buildable.name: Buddhist Monuments in the Hōryū-ji Area
buildable.justification: worship? -- active. The five-storey pagoda is five Wall boxes with stepped roofs.

buildable.name: Historic Monuments of Ancient Kyoto
buildable.justification: worship? -- active. Kinkaku-ji is three storeys of Wall on a plinth.

buildable.name: Historic Villages of Shirakawa-gō and Gokayama
buildable.justification: Gassho-zukuri farmhouses: a steep roof as stepped Wall courses, repeated across a village.

buildable.name: Hwaseong Fortress
buildable.justification: Suwon: 5.7 km of Wall with cited gates and bastions.

buildable.name: Fatehpur Sikri
buildable.justification: worship? -- the Jama Masjid is active. A whole city of red sandstone Colonnade and Wall, abandoned complete.

buildable.name: Qutb complex
buildable.justification: worship? -- the mosque is a ruin. A 72.5 m fluted Column, tapering -- the kit's tallest single primitive.

buildable.name: Red Fort
buildable.justification: Wall, 2.4 km of it, with the Diwan-i-Am as Colonnade.

buildable.name: Group of monuments at Mahabalipuram
buildable.justification: The Five Rathas are monolithic temples, each a stepped Wall mass.

buildable.name: Ayutthaya Historical Park
buildable.justification: Prangs as stepped Columns on Wall platforms.

buildable.name: Shibam
buildable.justification: Mud-brick towers up to eight storeys -- the oldest skyscraper city, and literally built of bricks.

buildable.name: Aït Benhaddou
buildable.justification: Earthen kasbah: Wall towers stacked up a hillside.

buildable.name: Medina of Marrakesh
buildable.justification: worship? -- the Koutoubia is active. The minaret is a Column of cited height.

buildable.name: Old Towns of Djenné
buildable.justification: worship? -- the Great Mosque is active and the largest mud-brick building in the world.

buildable.name: Monolithic churches in Lalibela
buildable.justification: worship? -- active. Churches cut DOWN into rock: the kit builds solids, not voids, and this is the site that says so.

buildable.name: Ruins of Aksum
buildable.justification: Stelae as Columns, the tallest 33 m and fallen.

buildable.name: Baalbek
buildable.justification: The Temple of Jupiter's six standing Columns, 20 m tall, cited.

buildable.name: Teotihuacan
buildable.justification: The Pyramid of the Sun and the Moon on the Avenue of the Dead: Pyramid, twice, on an axis.

buildable.name: Historic Centre of Mexico City and Xochimilco
buildable.justification: worship? -- the cathedral is active. Built on Tenochtitlan, which is the argument.

buildable.name: Pre-Hispanic Town of Uxmal
buildable.justification: The Pyramid of the Magician is elliptical in plan -- the second site to ask spex-build for an ellipse.

buildable.name: Tikal National Park
buildable.justification: Temple I as a steep stepped Pyramid with a roof comb.

buildable.name: Old Havana and its Fortification System
buildable.justification: Colonial Wall fronts and Colonnade arcades, a whole quarter of them.

buildable.name: Historic Center of Quito
buildable.justification: worship? -- active churches. A grid on a hillside: Wall and Stair.

buildable.name: Historic Town of Ouro Preto
buildable.justification: Baroque hill town: Wall fronts and two churches.

buildable.name: Independence Hall
buildable.justification: A brick Wall front with a Column steeple -- and the building where a constitution was argued, which this piece has views about.

buildable.name: Wartburg
buildable.justification: Wall and Column on a ridge -- a castle is the primitive set's home ground.

buildable.name: Berlin Modernism Housing Estates
buildable.justification: Taut's Hufeisensiedlung is one dwelling repeated 1 000 times around a horseshoe. Modular housing rendered by a modular system.

buildable.name: Museum Island
buildable.justification: The Altes Museum's front is eighteen Ionic columns: one Colonnade, cited.

buildable.name: Old town of Regensburg with Stadtamhof
buildable.justification: worship? -- the cathedral is active. The Steinerne Bruecke is sixteen Arches, cited and countable.

buildable.name: Fagus Factory
buildable.justification: Gropius's glass curtain wall as Mosaic on a Wall frame -- the building that starts modern architecture, and a grid.

buildable.name: Historic Centre of Vienna
buildable.justification: worship? -- the Stephansdom is active. The Ringstrasse blocks as Wall ranges.

buildable.name: Semmering railway
buildable.justification: Sixteen viaducts and fifteen tunnels: Arch, in the Alps.

buildable.name: Venice and its Lagoon
buildable.justification: The Doge's Palace is a Colonnade under a Wall -- the load-bearing inversion the building is famous for.

buildable.name: Historic Centre of Florence
buildable.justification: Brunelleschi's dome is an octagonal Dome on a Wall drum; the campanile is a Column.

buildable.name: Piazza del Duomo, Pisa
buildable.justification: worship? -- the cathedral is active. Four buildings, one of them leaning, all Colonnade and Arch.

buildable.name: Historic Centre of Siena
buildable.justification: The Torre del Mangia is a Column on the Campo's Wall front.

buildable.name: The Sassi and the Park of the Rupestrian Churches of Matera
buildable.justification: Matera: rock-cut dwellings stacked as Wall on Wall, the oldest continuously inhabited modular city on the list.

buildable.name: Historical Complex of Split with the Palace of Diocletian
buildable.justification: Split: a Roman palace with a town grown inside it -- Colonnade, Arch, Wall.

buildable.name: Old city (Dubrovnik)
buildable.justification: A complete circuit of Wall with towers. The primitive set's purest single-site demonstration after the Pont du Gard.

buildable.name: Archaeological Border complex of Hedeby and the Danevirke
buildable.justification: worship? -- imperial rather than congregational. Hue: a walled citadel with gates.

buildable.name: Cahokia
buildable.justification: Monks Mound is the largest earthwork in the Americas: a four-terrace Pyramid of earth.

buildable.name: Taos Pueblo
buildable.justification: Adobe dwellings stacked five storeys -- Wall on Wall, continuously inhabited for a thousand years.

buildable.name: Old Quebec
buildable.justification: Quebec: a walled town, Wall and Column, the only one north of Mexico.

excluded.name: Auschwitz
excluded.note: The German Nazi concentration and extermination camp. A site of industrialised mass murder is not a subject for toy bricks, under any framing.

excluded.name: Hiroshima Peace Memorial
excluded.note: The ruin left by the atomic bombing, preserved as it stood. The building is a record of the deaths beneath it.

excluded.name: Gorée
excluded.note: A centre of the Atlantic slave trade, and a memorial to it.

excluded.name: Robben Island
excluded.note: A political prison; the site is inscribed for what was done to the people held there.

excluded.name: Bikini Atoll
excluded.note: A nuclear test site: the population was displaced and the atoll is still uninhabitable.

excluded.name: Memorial sites of the Genocide: Nyamata, Murambi, Gisozi and Bisesero
excluded.note: The Rwandan genocide memorials at Nyamata, Murambi, Gisozi and Bisesero. Not named in the spec; found in the snapshot, and it belongs here for exactly the same reason Auschwitz does.

excluded.name: Murambi Genocide Memorial
excluded.note: A second Rwandan record in the snapshot; excluded on its own QID so a merge or split upstream cannot quietly re-admit it.

excluded.name: Cambodian Memorial Sites: From centres of repression to places of peace and reflection
excluded.note: Centres of repression under the Khmer Rouge. Not named in the spec; found in the snapshot.
